cat_long_refit.description: Jan-Nov refit of the ladder variant cat_long (CatBoost, nm_residual target, core_weather_nmclock features, clock_available route) at the ties-to-even rounded median of its two development best-iteration counts, on the same December-protected clock-present population as the frozen v6 refit. Fitted only if the selected candidate contains cat_long_25. Development scores use the two saved ladder development runs; nothing is refitted for development.

classifier_bagging.reason: The single-seed classifier's seasonal score varies with column subsampling alone: the eight members' density-only seasonal scores in the prototype ranged from -0.04% to -0.24% against v9 (forward -0.35% to -0.41%). Averaging removes that lottery from both the development scores and the export.
classifier_bagging.seed_rule: member k uses the v9 classifier seed plus k (k = 0..7) for LightGBM's seed; every member gets its own date-grouped inner rounds by the v9 rule; class probabilities are the equal mean over members

density_features.description: Six label-free day-level quantities added to the declared LIRF mixture classifier (all other classifier settings, features, bands, seed and the 0.75 mixture weight stay exactly as in configs/lirf_mixture_v1.json). Days are local Rome dates of the movement time. day_departures: LIRF departures that day; day_noclock_departures: LIRF departures that day with AOBT_3_flt and LOBT_flt both missing; day_delayed_share: share of LIRF departures that day whose schedule interval exceeds 3600 s; day_population_rows: population rows that day; day_population_mean_s: mean schedule interval of the population rows that day; window2h_population_rows: population rows whose movement time lies within two hours of the row's movement time (the row included). All are computable from supplied ranking rows; no label enters any of them.

floor_rule: Raise every prediction to at least the minimum departure label of the fitting rows (refit months for the export), applied last.

cat_long_25.description: On clock-available rows replace the incumbent prediction by 0.75 * incumbent + 0.25 * cat_long, where cat_long is the ladder variant's prediction (development: the saved fold predictions of the two hash-bound ladder runs; ranking: the declared Jan-Nov refit). Missing-clock rows are untouched.

density_classifier.description: Replace the v9 LIRF turnaround mixture by the same mixture whose three-class classifier additionally receives the six declared day-level features. Population, turnaround features, label modes, normal component, bands, schedule threshold (43200 s), inner date-grouped rounds rule, seed and parameters are those of configs/lirf_mixture_v1.json; the mixture weight stays 0.75. Rows above 43200 s stay at the incumbent.

route_negative_proxy.description: Where a Network Manager clock is available (AOBT_3_flt, else LOBT_flt) but MVT_TIME_UTC_mvt minus that clock is negative, replace the prediction by the no-clock fallback recipe cat_weather_v4_100 (development: the frozen weather fold predictions; ranking: the frozen v5 refit predictions). Applied after cat_long_25 on the same rows.

prior_evidence: Declared after same-day scratch prototypes on the two development folds against the exactly reconstructed v9 (314.2323 / 219.8750). The plan in docs/v10_plan.md listed four items; two are dropped on evidence: (a) a LIRF clock-present schedule-fill mixture scored at best 313.93 / 219.83 (-0.10% / -0.02%, paired-day intervals including zero), because the main models already carry the fill hedge from the same clock features (classifier AUC 0.87 with or without stand turnaround); (b) EGLL/LTFM/LFPG clock-present fills have an oracle bound of 0.28% / 0.32% of fold SSE, too small to survive imperfect separation. The remaining plan items scored: cat_long_25 313.8031 / 219.4705 (-0.137% / -0.184%); route_negative_proxy 313.8782 / 219.7693 (-0.113% / -0.048%); both 313.5015 / 219.4397 (-0.233% / -0.198%). A new day-level feature family for the LIRF population classifier was found on fitting months (Jan-Nov 2025, labels of the population only): the schedule-fill share is 65-69% on days with one or two population rows and 30-37% on days with eight or more, and 67% versus 32% at low versus high LIRF no-NM shares. Its prototype scored 313.5238 / 219.1117 alone (-0.225% / -0.347%) and 312.7914 / 218.6748 with both plan items (-0.459% / -0.546%). The plan's promotion margin of 0.5% on each fold was set for native model replacement; the accumulation above misses it on the seasonal fold by 0.04 points, on a fold whose SSE is 30% two unpredictable LFPG rows (labels 84240 and 58206 s with schedule intervals under 35 minutes and no NM record). This declaration therefore fixes a smaller margin together with a paired-day interval requirement, before any declared candidate is scored; the declared implementation recomputes every number from scratch and the prototype figures above play no further role. RESULT OF THAT FIRST DECLARATION (configs/v10_v1.json, runs/v10/selection.json): no candidate was eligible. The single-seed declared classifier scored density alone 314.0717 / 219.0566 (-0.051% / -0.372%), density+cat_long+route 313.3406 / 218.6196 (-0.284% / -0.571%) with a seasonal paired-day interval of [-1.794, +0.022], failing the interval condition by 0.022 s; cat_long+route (313.5015 / 219.4397, -0.233% / -0.198%) failed the 0.25% margin. The scratch prototype's better seasonal density score came only from a different column order under feature subsampling. A same-day scratch prototype of an eight-seed bagged classifier scored density alone 313.7757 / 219.0386 (-0.145% / -0.380%) and density+cat_long+route 313.0439 / 218.6016 (-0.378% / -0.579%) with paired-day intervals [-2.221, -0.212] and [-2.176, -0.381]. This second declaration changes only the classifier to that bagged form; items, candidates, margin and interval rule are unchanged from the first declaration, and its scores are recomputed from scratch.
selection: Reconstruct v9 exactly on both complete folds (v7 from the frozen runs, then the declared v9 mixture refitted on the fold's fitting months; both scores must reproduce the recorded development scores to 1e-6). Score the seven fixed candidates with the declared eight-member bagged classifier. A candidate is eligible when, on EACH fold, its complete RMSE is at least 0.25% below v9 and the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval of its RMSE difference to v9 lies entirely below zero. Choose the eligible candidate with the lowest equally weighted mean RMSE ratio; otherwise select nothing. Classifier and floor parameters come from the fold's fitting months only; the cat_long and fallback fold predictions are the frozen saved runs; no scoring, stopping, December or ranking label enters any parameter. Common weights at all rows; no airport, threshold, weight or feature search.
